verdict: Capati is much lighter and easy to fit into your daily diet. Naan cheese is tasty, but better as a treat.
why: Naan cheese is about 450 kcal, capati around 120 kcal. One naan cheese is almost the same as 4 pieces of capati.
Naan cheese has more protein (15 g vs 4 g), but almost 4 times the calories.
Naan cheese has about 21 g fat compared to 3 g in capati.
Naan cheese is soft, rich and easy to finish fast. Capati is easier to control, 1-2 pieces is enough.
when_a: Naan cheese is okay when you share it with family or at a celebration, and eat it with tandoori chicken without other oily dishes.
when_b: Capati suits a daily dinner or breakfast, with dhal or chicken curry.
tip: Eat capati with dhal and a piece of tandoori chicken for protein. If you want naan cheese, cut it up and share.

faq.a: Yes, many people choose capati because it's light. Make sure you pair it with a protein dish so you don't get hungry late at night.

faq.q: Isn't the protein in naan cheese good?
faq.a: The protein is fine, but it comes with a lot of fat and calories. Dishes like tandoori chicken are a more efficient way to get protein.
